summary: A sale or livestream banner with title, discount and prices, a flip-digit countdown to a real start or end time, a CTA, and an Ended mark once the time has passed.
by: opus, checked by sonnet, revised by opus

items.behaviour: The demo shows four banners stacked vertically, in a column at most 60rem wide with a 1rem gap, each a rounded card with a hairline border
items.expect: In en, from top to bottom: (1) 'Studio Headphones, launch week', discount '40% OFF', '$77' and struck-through '$129', CTA 'Shop headphones'; (2) 'Live shopping: Studio Headphones Q&A', '15% OFF', '$109' / '$129', CTA 'Remind me'; (3) '11.11 only: second water bottle 40% off', '40% OFF', 'NT$594' / 'NT$990', CTA 'Shop now'; (4) 'Desk Lamp, weekend price', '25% OFF', '$66' / '$88', with no CTA. Each title is a level 2 heading and each subtitle sits under it in muted text

items.behaviour: Once the demo is on screen each timer shows zero-padded two-digit groups for the time left, floored to whole seconds, with a unit label under each group and a ':' between groups
items.trigger: initial render, first second on screen
items.expect: Banner 1 reads 03 : 05 : 11 : 59 under Days, Hrs, Min, Sec (the target is set a few ms before the first reading and seconds are floored, so 12 : 00 is never shown), with the small label 'Ends in' above. Banner 3 reads 04 : 25 : 59 under Hrs, Min, Sec, with no Days group. Banner 4 reads 00 : 00 : 00 under Hrs, Min, Sec. Each digit is its own split-flap tile (about 1.6rem wide, 2.25rem tall) with a thin line across its middle

items.behaviour: Before the current time is read, no ticking digits, date line or timer name are output. With dateLabel the timer area holds only a date sentence; without it every digit is '--'. The ended look and CTA removal are not applied yet
items.trigger: render CountdownBanner to HTML on the server (renderToString) with each demo banner's props (the demo wrapper itself renders nothing on the server)
items.expect: Banner 2 props: the timer area holds only 'Starts every Wed, 8:00 PM (GMT+8)', no 'Starts in' label and no tiles. Banners 1, 3 and 4 props: 'Ends in' over four groups of '--' tiles (Days included), no date line, timer element with no aria-label, empty status region. Banner 4 props still output its CTA 'Shop lamps' as a <button type="button"> (no ctaHref), with no Ended mark and the discount in the accent colour; in the browser it is replaced by the ended state on the first tick

items.behaviour: The countdown updates once a second and only digits whose value changed flip
items.trigger: watch banner 1 or 3 while it runs
items.expect: The value changes every 1000 ms. On a changed digit the upper half folds down to rotateX -90 over 0.16 s easeIn, then the lower half folds from rotateX 90 to 0 over 0.16 s easeOut after a 0.16 s delay. The flip leaf is removed 340 ms after the change, so a digit never stays mid-flip. Digits that did not change do not move

items.behaviour: The Days group is shown only while at least one whole day remains; when days drops to 0 the Days group and its ':' are removed from a running timer
items.trigger: control the page clock (for example Playwright page.clock) and advance banner 1 until less than 24 hours remain
items.expect: Banner 1 goes from 01 : 00 : 00 : 00 under Days, Hrs, Min, Sec to 23 : 59 : 59 under Hrs, Min, Sec only, with two ':' separators. Its accessible name becomes 'Time left: 0 Days 23 Hrs 59 Min'

items.behaviour: A small muted date note sits under the timer, formatted in the viewer's time zone and the block locale with short weekday, short month, day, hour and two-digit minute
items.trigger: initial render, after the first tick
items.expect: Banners 1 and 3: 'Ends <date>' (for example 'Ends Thu, Nov 26, 6:12 PM'), the end time of the offer. Banner 4: 'Ended <date>' giving a time one hour before page load. Banner 2: 'Starts <date>' before the stream starts, 'Ends <date>' while it is live

items.behaviour: A banner with a startDate counts down to the start, then shows Live now and counts down to the end, then ends. The demo stream starts every Wednesday 12:00 UTC (20:00 GMT+8) and lasts 1 hour; if this week's session has finished it targets next week's
items.trigger: set the page clock to a Wednesday 11:59:50 UTC before loading the demo, then let it run past 12:00:00 UTC
items.expect: Before 12:00 UTC banner 2 shows the small label 'Starts in', timer 00 : 00 : 09 under Hrs, Min, Sec counting down, date line 'Starts <date>'. At 12:00 UTC the label row shows a small filled dot plus 'Live now' in foreground colour followed by 'Ends in', the timer jumps to 00 : 59 : 59 and counts down, and the date line reads 'Ends <date>'. The CTA 'Remind me' stays in both phases

items.behaviour: A banner whose end time has passed shows the ended look: discount and timer at 40% opacity, discount muted instead of the accent colour, a muted 'Ended' mark centred over the discount and price area, and no CTA
items.trigger: initial render of banner 4 (end time one hour in the past)
items.expect: '25% OFF' at opacity 0.4 in muted colour, muted text 'Ended' over it with no tick disc, timer 00 : 00 : 00 at opacity 0.4 under the label 'Ends in', date line 'Ended <date>', no button or link. The Ended mark is fully opaque on the first frame with no fade. The timer does not change afterwards

items.behaviour: When a running banner reaches its end while on screen, it switches to the ended look, the Ended mark fades in, the CTA is removed and ticking stops
items.trigger: control the page clock and advance it past banner 3's end time (or past 13:00 UTC on banner 2 in the livestream scenario)
items.expect: On the tick at the end the timer reads 00 : 00 : 00 at opacity 0.4, the discount turns muted at opacity 0.4, the 'Ended' mark fades from opacity 0 to 1 over 0.15 s easeOut, the CTA disappears in the same frame with no exit animation, and the date line changes from 'Ends <date>' to 'Ended <date>'. No further updates happen

items.behaviour: Tab stops only on the CTAs, one per banner that is not ended, in document order. Digits, labels, the Ended mark and the discount are not focusable
items.trigger: press Tab repeatedly from the top of the demo
items.expect: Focus goes to 'Shop headphones', then 'Remind me', then 'Shop now', then leaves the demo. Banner 4 has no stop. Each CTA shows a 2px focus ring with a 2px offset on keyboard focus

items.behaviour: With ctaHref the CTA is a link; every visible CTA in the demo is a link. It is 40px tall with the accent fill and dims on hover
items.trigger: focus a demo CTA and press Enter, or hover it with a mouse
items.expect: Each visible CTA is an <a href="#">; Enter follows it (the URL gains '#'). On hover the CTA drops to opacity 0.9

items.behaviour: Pressing a CTA scales it down slightly with a spring and releases back
items.trigger: press and hold on a CTA, then release
items.expect: Scale goes to 0.97 while pressed and back to 1 on release, spring stiffness 520, damping 34

items.behaviour: The countdown is exposed as a timer whose accessible name gives days, hours and minutes (floored, no seconds), and it does not announce every tick. The digit groups and unit labels are hidden from assistive tech
items.trigger: inspect the timer in the accessibility tree once the demo is on screen
items.expect: Banner 1: role timer, aria-live off, name 'Time left: 3 Days 5 Hrs 11 Min' from the first named render (12 Min never appears). Banner 3: 'Time left: 0 Days 4 Hrs 25 Min'. Banner 2 before the start: 'Starts in N Days N Hrs N Min'. Banner 4: 'Ended'. The digit groups are aria-hidden

items.behaviour: A visually hidden polite status region holds 'Live now' only while a banner is live and is empty otherwise; the original price is read with a prefix
items.trigger: inspect the DOM of banner 2 before and during the live phase (clock scenario above); read the price lines
items.expect: The role=status region is empty before the start, contains 'Live now' during the live hour, and is empty again after the end. The visible dot and 'Live now' are aria-hidden so it is not read twice. The struck-through price is preceded by sr-only text so it reads 'Was $129'. The Ended mark is aria-hidden

items.behaviour: With reduced motion requested, digits change without flipping, the CTA does not scale on press, and the Ended mark appears without fading. The countdown still ticks every second
items.trigger: enable prefers-reduced-motion, watch a running timer, press a CTA, and advance the clock past an end time
items.expect: Digit values swap in place each second with no fold. CTA scale stays 1 on press. The 'Ended' mark is at opacity 1 on the frame the banner ends. Text, layout and timing are otherwise unchanged

items.behaviour: Ticking stops while the page is hidden, and on return the time is read again at once so the display jumps to the correct remaining time instead of resuming from the old value
items.trigger: hide the tab for 10 seconds, then return to it
items.expect: While hidden no updates happen. On return the seconds read about 10 fewer than when hidden, on the first visible tick, and each digit that changed flips once (no flip with reduced motion); then updates continue every 1000 ms. If the end passed while hidden, the banner shows the ended state on return and the 'Ended' mark fades in over 0.15 s as in a live crossing

items.behaviour: Labels follow the demo locale, and the banner switches from a stacked layout to three columns when the banner is at least 48rem wide
items.trigger: switch the demo locale to zh-TW, zh-CN or ja; resize the container across 48rem
items.expect: zh-TW: units 天 時 分 秒, '倒數', '已結束', '進行中', '距離開始', price prefix '原價', name '距離結束還有 3 天 5 時 11 分'. zh-CN: 天 时 分 秒, '倒计时', '已结束', '进行中', '距离开始', '原价', name '距离结束还有 3 天 5 小时 11 分', CTA '选购耳机'. ja: 日 時間 分 秒, '終了まで', '終了', '開催中', '開始まで', '通常価格'. Below 48rem the title, discount and timer stack with horizontal hairlines between them; at 48rem and above they sit in one row (title column flexible, discount and timer columns sized to content) separated by vertical hairlines, and the title grows from text-lg to text-xl

items.behaviour: onStart and onEnd fire once each, only for a crossing seen while mounted; a banner already ended on load fires nothing. An invalid endDate never counts down. The demo passes neither callback, so this needs a test page
items.trigger: mount the block in a test page with onStart and onEnd spies and a controlled clock; separately mount it with endDate 'not a date'
items.expect: Crossing startDate calls onStart once; crossing the end calls onEnd once; mounting with endDate in the past calls neither. With an invalid endDate the timer stays as '--' groups with Days under 'Ends in', with no accessible name, no date line, and the CTA still shown
